CloudEvents 1.0.2 supports the portable envelope claim. Current Google SRE chapters support monitored release comparison and symptom/cause separation. RFC 3339 supports timestamp format limitations. NIST SP 800-128 supports configuration change-control records. Checked 2026-09-06.
